title: Menu photos rank by how strongly the source says menu and drop pixels and logos; a menu price keeps its printed number with the scale the menu states in any currency; a ScrapeCreators no-results answer is not a provider error and transient search failures are retried; past the photos a source labels as a menu, reading stops after 4 not-menus in a row (stopped-early), and a pressed button reads the next batch
steps: S1: Menu photo candidates: a source menu label, a short title or alt or path naming a menu, page-shaped graphics outside portrait feeds, other graphics, then posts whose long caption only mentions a menu; pixels under 100 px and words saying logo are dropped.

S2: Menu price scale: model answers and printed suffixes in several currencies (VND header note, IDR rb/ribu, KRW 천/만, COP M/K) and full-amount menus (USD, AED, VND full); merge, summary, place view, brief, agent part and prompt, pinned copy, research-sourced gate; plugin and /ops display.
S3: Social web search: ScrapeCreators 404 not_found body, 5xx, 429, unreadable body, 401, 402; findSocialPages fall-through and stop rules; the executor settles a not-charged search at 0 cents.
S4: Stop early: menu photo scope and reader with labeled photos and guesses; a research run and Read menu again on a scratch database; the plugin and /ops photo result line.
expect: S1: order google, titled, page, story, square, post; the 1x1 named pixel and the logo are not candidates; a portrait social post is not page-shaped.

S2: price stays the printed number; priceScale is 1, 1000, 10000 or 1000000 only as the menu states it, null when unsure, never inferred from the currency; glass and bottle are two items of one dish each with its size; 110 with scale 1000 equals 110.000 printed in full; displays show 110K / 1.485M, the site writes 110,000; prompts name no currency.

S3: a 404 not_found is an empty answer marked charged false and the next query runs; transient failures are asked once more (a rate limit after a pause) then fall to the next provider or query; quota and a bad key stop the network with their reason; a not-charged search settles at 0 cents.

S4: labeled photos are always read; past them 4 not-menus in a row stop the reading and the rest are stopped-early, not over-limit; only a menu reading resets the streak; an automatic run keeps the stop, a pressed button reads the next batch of up to 4 and its preview counts them; a result a client does not know reads as not read yet. A phone search with no result (ScrapeCreators 404) still lets the site: query run.

selectors.api: menu.items[].priceScale and otherPrices[].priceScale on GET /api/website-opportunities/:id and GET /api/ops/wo/places/:id

evidence: Stand 24/10/2026: Fern Hollow 53 candidates, 13 of 24 reads went to posts that mention a menu and a 1x1 pixel (all not-menu); Iron Fence Saigon read 110 and 1485 for a VND menu printing thousands; Iron Fence instagram-search and Reverb facebook-search failed provider_error because ScrapeCreators answers no results with HTTP 404 (reproduced live, credits_charged 0). Dev 24/10/2026 (Kirami Sushi Bar, job 7036a8f9): the phone query asked with region AE answered 404 no results, so each network stopped after one counted query.
fence: Candidate ranking from stored generic signals only; price scale only from what the menu states; search errors classified by type

tests: candidates: a post that only mentions a menu goes last; pixels and logos are dropped; page-shaped graphics first
a scale the menu states is recorded beside the printed number, in any currency
full amounts are never scaled: dollars, dirhams, and a menu the reader says prints full amounts
a printed short form states its scale; a full amount, a currency after it or a non-price never invents one
the menu prompt asks for the stated scale and one item per size with the size set
a price printed in thousands is compared as its amount, kept as printed, and its scale travels with it
the place view carries a price printed in thousands as printed, with priceScale 1000
a price printed in thousands reaches the agent with its scale, and the prompt says how to write it
a price the research printed in thousands is sourced when the build writes its full amount
web search: a ScrapeCreators "no results" settles at 0 cents and the next query runs
scrapeCreatorsGoogleSearch: a 404 "no results" is an empty answer, marked not charged
scrapeCreatorsGoogleSearch: 5xx, a rate limit and an unreadable body are transient; no credit and a bad key are not
find: a query every provider failed on twice falls through to the next query
find: a rate limit is asked once more after a pause
find: a permanent refusal (no credit, bad key) stops the network with its reason
a menu item printed in thousands keeps its printed price and says the amount in the brief
a shortened dish price is written as its full amount in the site language; a full or unknown one as printed
a shortened price shows as the amount it means; full or unknown scales show as printed; so do other prices
a shortened price shows as the amount it means, other prices too; full or unknown scales as printed
scope: past the labeled photos, reading stops after 4 guesses in a row that are not menus
scope: the labeled photos are never cut short, however many are not menus
scope: only a menu reading resets the streak; unreadable and same-menu neither count nor reset
scope: a person pressing the button reads the next 4 past the stop, within the limit and the frozen list
photos past the stop are recorded stopped-early, not over the limit, and are not read
a menu among the guesses resets the streak as the run reads, so the run reads on
a person pressing the button reads the next batch past an earlier stop; an automatic run does not
menu photos past 4 not-menus in a row stop early; Read menu again previews and reads the next batch
a photo past the not-menu streak says it was not read because the photos before it were not menus
a photo past the not-menu streak says why it was not read; an unknown result reads as not read yet
